summary: I wonder if we could pool our resources, use or budgets, or look for other grants #ctcasl. The cost per user/student would be $30 a year, we could pool our resources to bring in @cogdog as online coach. Scales easily. I could do on the ground events.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: I wonder if we could pool our resources, use or budgets, or look for other grants #ctcasl. The cost per user/student would be $30 a year, we could pool our resources to bring in @cogdog as online coach. Scales easily. I could do on the ground events.
